single_variable: Admission only: last confirmed 5m volume divided by SMA(volume,50), including that bar, >= 1.2. No search. Wick uses the touch bar; allin3 uses the preceding bar as its limit is resting. Missing complete contiguous window skips.
diagnostic: Count same-direction strict 20-bar break and close back inside with the same volume test, on the same eligible bar. No secondary portfolio rule.
comparison: Original native fills and allocator, baseline must reproduce saved account. Compare full-history accounts; also the registered 2025 starts. Random masks preserve counts within NY event week, side and pre-feature volatility bucket, on existing candidates; sparse strata may be fixed. This addresses selection among existing entries, not the strategy vs new random trades.
vol_bucket: floor(2*log2(mean true range of the 14 bars immediately before the last eligible bar / their last close)).
fees: Saved fills: wick market entry taker 5bp+10bp slippage; target maker 2bp, other exits taker 5bp+10bp slippage. Allin3 entry maker 2bp, same target and non-target charges. Binance candles; funding excluded.
